salt_name.description: Name of the salt used in the experiment

process_run_id.description: Identifier of the automated process run as recorded in eLabFTW

replicates.description: Number of replicate wells per condition

resin_mass_mg.description: Mass of resin used in the plate per well

ligand_name.description: Name or identifier of the ligand

total_volume_ul.description: Total liquid volume per well during incubation

venting_time_s.description: Venting time in the automated protocol

pump_duration_s.description: Duration of pump operation for loading

incubation_time_min.description: Incubation time of the loading step

salt_concentrations.description: List of salt concentrations used across the plate

equilibration_cycles.description: Number of equilibration cycles before loading

ligand_concentrations.description: List of initial ligand concentrations loaded onto resin

calibration_curve_slope.description: Slope of calibration curve used to convert absorbance to concentration

salt_stock_concentration.description: Concentration of the prepared salt stock solution

ligand_concentration_unit.description: Unit of ligand concentrations (e.g., µM, mM)

calibration_curve_intercept.description: Intercept of calibration curve used to convert absorbance to concentration

number_of_salt_concentrations.description: Number of distinct salt concentrations on the plate

number_of_ligand_concentrations.description: Number of distinct ligand concentrations on the plate

analysis_status.description: Status of the Tecan loading isotherm analysis

analysis_timestamp.description: Timestamp when results were committed to the database

analysis_message.description: Summary message from the analysis script

warnings.description: List of warnings issued during analysis

summary.description: Key numerical summary metrics from Langmuir fits

max_initial_ligand_concentration.description: Maximum initial ligand concentration across the plate

num_fit_results.description: Number of Langmuir fits (one per salt concentration)

mean_q_max.description: Mean of fitted q_max values over salts, ignoring failed fits

mean_K.description: Mean of fitted Langmuir K values over salts, ignoring failed fits

mean_R2.description: Mean R^2 of Langmuir fits over salts, ignoring failed fits

fit_results.description: Per-salt Langmuir fit results from the analysis script

R2.description: Coefficient of determination for the fit

metadata.description: Metadata echoed from analysis script (concentrations, units, etc.)

data_files.description: Output data file paths from analysis

analysis_results_json.description: Path to main analysis JSON file

tecan_raw_excel.description: Path to raw Tecan Excel file used in analysis

isotherms_png.description: Path to loading isotherm plot PNG

all_result_files.description: All files present in the ../results folder

analysis_folder_files.description: All files present in the ../analysis folder (if it exists)
